description: Announces a meetup from an event's organizer or a personal event's host to the holders of the event's Wallet pass. Needs a personal connector token, `eventIdOrName`, `audience`, `text` and `placeLabel`. `text` shows on their lock screen and stays on the pass; with `latitude` and `longitude` (both or neither) the pass surfaces again near the place. The reply's `noticeId` names the meetup. Without `confirm` it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it sends. Only the hosts or the organizer can send. "my_booth" returns VENDOR_OFF. Six an hour per event, shared with event_pass_notice, then RATE_LIMITED.

at.description: Optional time, with a time zone.

audience.description: everyone, tier, intent, serials, booth, meetup_yes or meetup_no.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

relevantText.description: Optional line shown near the place. Default: "Sonar meetup inside, show this pass."

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id sends once.

text.description: One plain line, up to 120 characters. No links or markup.

name: event_meetup_announce
title: Announce a meetup
